subject: Using hooks to specify graphics size

messages.author: 71171f0d61fc140f
messages.subject: Using hooks to specify graphics size
parts:
I'm putting together a document where the dimensions of my figures are either going to be square, or rectangular. I'd like to specify this with a chunk option like fig.shape="rect" and a corresponding chunk hook.  I think I'm nearly there, but what I've got so far isn't quite working yet:

\SweaveOpts{dev="png", fig.shape = "square"}

<<>>=
fig.shape.fun <- fig.shape.fun <- function(before, options, envir){
  ## To be run before the chunk
  if(before){
    ## Don't overwrite manually set fig.height, fig.width
    if(is.null(options$fig.width) & is.null(options$fig.height)){
      if(options$fig.shape == "square"){
        opts_current$set(fig.width = 5, fig.height=5)
      }else if(options$fig.shape == "rect"){
        opts_current$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height=5)
      }
    }
  }
}

knit_hooks$set(
  fig.shape = fig.shape.fun
)
@

But, this doesn't work. Setting fig.shape="square" and fig.shape="rect" doesn't seem to have any effect on the graphics which are produced.

-Joe

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Using hooks to specify graphics size
parts:
This is an interesting application, but I guess you do not actually
need that much power (hooks are designed for pirates of the
Caribbean).

I wonder if this suffices in your case:

\SweaveOpts{fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}

when you want square plots, you just change 8 to 5. These are global
settings, and they can be overridden by local options in chunks, e.g

<<one-plot, fig.width=4.8, fig.height=3.2>>=
# I will produce a plot of 4.8x3.2 inches
plot(1)
@

<<another-plot>>=
# my dimension is 8x5
plot(1)
@

Or I misunderstood what was going on?

Regards,
Yihui
